scientific_integrity: The two-positive-root equilibrium regime was reported previously; only the global basin partition and initial-parasite sensitivity are advanced here. Finite simulations are not proof. A residual unindexed-literature risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Positive parameters and initial states; strict host-extinction and two-root inequalities. Global separatrix formula is implicit; explicit derivative only at vanishing host density. No global result for host-persistent or fold cases.
title: Initial-condition basin threshold and parasite-sensitive rescue in a harvested commensal system
